papers.title: Early-time dynamics of the Richtmyer-Meshkov instability at Kelvin-Voigt viscoelastic interfaces
papers.summary: The Richtmyer-Meshkov instability (RMI) is initiated when a shock wave interacts with a perturbed interface between two materials, imparting an initial velocity to the interfacial perturbation. When the materials are viscoelastic, the subsequent evolution is influenced by the coupled effects of inertia, viscous dissipation, and elastic resistance.

papers.title: Conjugate heat transfer in turbulent pipe flow with azimuthally non-uniform heating
papers.summary: Turbulent conjugate heat transfer (CHT) in pipes with azimuthally non-uniform heating is studied theoretically and numerically with a focus on low-$\mathrm{Pr}$ fluids. While the influence of the solid properties is well documented for uniform heat flux, their effect under azimuthally non-uniform heating has not been explored systematically.

papers.title: Influencing factors and physical mechanism of rheological evolution of oil-based complex fluids at ultralow temperatures
papers.summary: Extreme low-temperature environments pose significant challenges to fluid physics. It is urgent to maintain good rheological behavior of oil-based complex fluids under extreme, low-temperature conditions.

papers.title: The weakly nonlinear admittance at open ends of two- and three-dimensional acoustic waveguides
papers.summary: We formulate a weakly nonlinear exit condition for open ends of acoustic waveguides; to our knowledge, this is the first time a general acoustic open end has been analysed outside the linear regime. The formulation neglects mean flow, vortex separation and viscous effects.

papers.title: Wave scattering by a sloping beach of an arbitrary angle. Revisited: regular solution
papers.summary: In this paper, we revisit the classic problem of a wave field on a sloping beach of an arbitrary angle and propose a general approach that allows the computation of regular solutions of the problem regardless of the angle. We use the Mellin-transform technique, reducing the problem to singular integral equations with fixed-point singularities of a special kind.

papers.title: Spatiotemporal instability and topological bifurcations of a weakly elastic film flowing down a vertical fibre
papers.summary: This paper investigates the temporal, spatiotemporal and nonlinear instability of a weakly viscoelastic liquid film flowing down a vertical cylindrical fibre. The fluid is described by the Walters’ liquid B model, and the analysis combines long-wave asymptotic modelling, a long-wave-weighted Orr–Sommerfeld stability analysis and nonlinear numerical simulations.
